title: DS fact model: lifecycle and no-op reassertion discipline
preamble:
# DS fact model: lifecycle and no-op reassertion discipline

This document covers:

1. The two fact lifecycle categories (`logical` / `ttl`)
   declared on every schema, and what the choice commits an
   adapter (or rule) to at runtime.
2. The **no-op reassertion discipline** — the engine-side
   contract that `logical` fact semantics depend on.

Paired with [LGRA],
which specifies the syntax for the lifecycle modifier; this
doc specifies the runtime semantics the modifier implies.

## What this is not

- Not a schema-declaration grammar reference — that's
  [LGRA].
- Not a cross-tier fact-flow specification — see
  [LTIE] for the language-side contract
  and [RARC] for the
  runtime-side mechanism.
- Not an implementation guide for adapter authors —
  adapter-specific docs own the per-system details of
  meaningful-change filtering.
